site_name: Bus Shelter And Advertising Right South Of 1 To 21 Fineran Court
description: Display of 2 x internally illuminated advertisement to allow static and dynamic content display with automatic rotation of images to existing bus shelter
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The maximum steady brightness of the advertisement hereby permitted is not to exceed 300 candelas per sq.m. 
Reason: To ensure the sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 3 - The advertisement hereby approved shall not display any animated or video content unless it is below the VAMM maximum threshold. 
Reason:In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - No music, smoke or sound shall be emitted from the advertisements. 
Reason: In the interest of the aural amenities of the locality in accordance with Council Policy LP2 and LP9 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 5 -  INFORMATIVE: The footway and carriageway of the A3036/St Johns Hill should not be blocked during the relocation and installation works. Temporary obstructions during the development works should be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on the A3036/St Johns Hill. All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions. 

INFORMATIVE: No skips or construction materials shall be kept on the footway or carriageway on the TLRN at any time.

INFORMATIVE: Bus services and passengers waiting on the pavement should not be impacted during the replacement of the advertisement panel.

INFORMATIVE: All vehicles associated with the installation and maintenance of adverts must only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
